Includes:

Pages

Pages are used to create, share, and edit knowledge. These are living documents you can create and update for almost anything – from project plans, meeting notes, policies and more.

Spaces

Spaces are how you organize pages into meaningful categories, like different folders where you can store your work.

Organize and connect work with databases

Confluence databases are a central source of info that dramatically changes the way that teams can organize, reference, and display data in Confluence. Learn more.

Templates for Marketing, Product, Program Management and more

Get started quickly by using the template library. From product requirement documents to marketing plans, there’s a template that’s perfect fit for your project.

Up to 3 active whiteboards per user

Confluence whiteboards brings the flexibility of a digital whiteboard into your team workspace. Collaborate, brainstorm, draw and visualize ideas in a freeform way with up to 3 active whiteboards per user. Learn more.

10 automation rule runs per month

Increase efficiency by replacing manual, time-consuming work with automated processes and workflows. With Free, unlock 10 automation rule runs per instance per month. Learn more.

Support for apps and integrations

Integrate Confluence with other apps you’re already using. Learn more.

Support from Atlassian Community

Get support from the Atlassian Community, a public forum of community experts where you can ask questions. You can also access free Confluence guides and knowledge base articles.

Up to 2 GB file storage

Standard

Everything you need to get started

$5.42

per user / month

Start free trial

Everything from Free plus:

Rovo Search, Chat, and Agents, with integrated AI-powered work features

Unlock knowledge, create together, and tackle the biggest challenges with Rovo Search, Chat, and specialized Agents.

Free guest access

Invite external partners to collaborate as guests in your Confluence site. Guests are free of charge, up to 5 guests per paid user.

You can also share view-only Confluence pages via public links. This can be useful for sharing information to the public, like customer FAQs and release notes.

Advanced permissions

Control who can view, edit and comment on your pages, so important information can stay restricted until you’re ready to share.

100 automation rule runs per month

Increase efficiency by replacing manual, time-consuming work with automated processes and workflows. With Standard, unlock 100 automation rule runs per instance per month. Learn more.

250 GB of storage

9/5 regional support

Customer support during business hours is available with Confluence Standard plan. Learn more.

Up to 150,000 users per site

RECOMMENDED

Premium

Connect work across teams

$10.44

per user / month

Start free trial

Everything from Standard plus:

Unlimited pages

Pages are used to create, share, and edit knowledge. These are living documents you can create and update for almost anything – from project plans, meeting notes, policies and more. You can create as many pages as you need.

Unlimited spaces

Spaces are how you organize pages into meaningful categories, like different folders where you can store your work. You can create as many spaces as you need.

Dynamic intranet

Customize a dynamic info hub for your entire company with company hub, a single go-to destination for company news, announcements, and resources. Learn more.

10x more automations

Save time by automating repetitive, manual tasks to organize and manage content at scale. Get started quickly with out-of-the box templates or build your own powerful, custom rules by using the low-code / no-code rule builder and with AI. With Premium, unlock up to 1,000 automations per user per month. Learn more.

Unlimited whiteboards

Confluence whiteboards brings the flexibility of a digital whiteboard into your team workspace. With Premium, unlock unlimited whiteboards and advanced Jira integrations to brainstorm, plan and action work like never before. Learn more.

Admin controls and insights

Inspect permissions to specify who can do and create what, and fix permission problems quickly with an admin key. Manage site health, get actionable alerts, and unlock site-level insights, all in one place.

Unlimited storage

24/7 support for critical issues

Get Premium support around the clock from a dedicated team with 1-hour response times to critical issues. Learn more.

99.9% uptime SLA

Enterprise

Advanced analytics, scale and security for enterprises

Billed annually. Switch to Annual billing above to view Enterprise pricing.
Contact sales

Everything from Premium plus:

Cross-product insights with Atlassian Analytics and Data Lake

Aggregate data from across your Atlassian toolchain for holistic insights that drive better decision making.

Advanced admin controls and security

Manage users and security at scale with advanced governance controls like advanced encryption and Shadow IT controls.

Enterprise-grade identity and access management

Get support for multiple identity providers (IdPs) within your central admin console, plus SCIM, enforce SSO, and more with Atlassian Guard Standard included.

Unlimited automations

Increase efficiency by replacing manual, time-consuming work with automated processes and workflows. Learn more.

Multiple sites (up to 150)

Enable data isolation and administrative autonomy. Customize each instance to the needs of the teams who use it.

24/7 support for all issues

Get help 24/7 via dedicated phone number and senior team, with 30 minute response time for critical issues. Learn more.

99.95% uptime SLA

Core Features.
				


User limit per site

This is the maximum number of users or user licenses you can add to each of your Confluence sites.

	
10 users
	
150,000 users
	
150,000 users
	
150,000 users



Number of sites

This is the number of sites (also called “instances”) you can license based on the subscription plan you choose.

One site is typically enough for most small to medium organizations because you can still have multiple pages on a single site for different teams to maintain their knowledge bases, workflows, etc.

Enterprise subscribers often opt for multiple sites, up to 150 per product, to:

Learn more about instances in Confluence.

	
One
	
One
	
One
	
Up to 150



Whiteboards

Confluence whiteboards brings the flexibility of a digital whiteboard into your team workspace, allowing you to brainstorm, plan, and action work like never before
Learn more

	
3 active whiteboards per user
	
10 active whiteboards per user
	
Unlimited
	
Unlimited



Automation

Build flexible rules to reduce repetitive, manual tasks – from archiving content to notifying teams. Automation helps your teams save time, increase efficiency, and reduce risk of manual errors.

Free plan comes with 10 rule runs per month while Standard plan comes with 100.

Premium users have 1,000 rule executions per paid monthly user. For example, a Confluence Cloud Premium site with 200 users will have 200,000 monthly rule executions each month.

Enterprise sites have unlimited automation executions.

You only pay for what you use - only automations that successfully perform an action count towards your limit.

Learn more about automation.

	
10 rule runs per month
	
100 rule runs per month
	
1,000 rule runs per user per month
	
Unlimited



Unlimited spaces and pages

Create as much content as your team needs with unlimited pages and spaces.

	
	
	
	



Databases

Confluence databases allow users to aggregate, structure, and connect information, driving consistency and visibility across teams. Learn more.

	
	
	
	



Macros

Macros add interactivity to your Confluence pages with extra functionality or dynamic content.

For example, use the Jira Issues macro to attach live updates of Jira issues, epics, and reports to a page. Or, use the Status macro to update your team on your project’s status.

	
	
	
	



Structured page tree organization

Organize the content in your pages easily with a hierarchy. Page tree hierarchies can make finding work quick.

	
	
	
	



Page versioning

Track and view the history of changes to each page, compare different versions, and roll back to a previous version if needed.

	
	
	
	



Template library

Use the template library for everything from product requirement documents to marketing plans. Or, create your own custom template.

	
	
	
	


Apps and integrations
	
	
	
	



Goals, projects, and communication

BETA

Share status updates on how projects and goals are progressing.

	
	
	
	



Employee directory for people and teams

Know who you’re working with and what they're working on.

	
	
	
	



Space and page permissions

Assign, revoke, and modify space or page permissions to individual users, groups, or anonymous users. The Free plan doesn’t allow permission settings for spaces or pages.

	
	
	
	



Archive and unarchive pages

Archive outdated pages to keep page trees organized with relevant content. Access archived pages any time for historical context.

	
	
	
	



Page insights

Get engagement analytics on page views and user views.

	
	
	
	



Atlassian Rovo

NEW

Unlock knowledge, create together, and tackle the biggest challenges with Rovo Search, Chat, and specialized Agents. Learn more.

	
	
25 Rovo credits per user per month
100 indexed objects per user
	
70 Rovo credits per user per month
250 indexed objects per user
	
150 Rovo credits per user per month
625 indexed objects per user



Dynamic intranet

Customize a dynamic info hub for your entire company with company hub, a single go-to destination for company news, announcements, and resources. Learn more.

	
	
	
	



Analytics

Analytics lets you see user engagement and make more informed decisions with filters for the site, space, and page levels.

	
	
	
	



Inspect permissions

Understand all active permissions for a specific user in one place so you can address issues quickly.

	
	
	
	



Content manager

Space admins can efficiently oversee and manage various types of content, such as pages, blogs, and attachments, from a centralized interface. It also supports bulk actions like archiving, deleting, and updating content owners, making it easier to manage the space at scale. 

These actions save time and effort by enabling admins to manage large volumes of content efficiently, ensuring a more organized and manageable Confluence space.

Learn more.

	
	
	
	



Team calendars

Share and embed team calendars. This can help teams communicate availability and stay organized.

	
	
	
	


Data & insights
				


Atlassian Analytics

Build interactive, customizable charts, and dashboards across products and instances with a low- to no-code editor.

Learn more about Atlassian Analytics.

	
	
	
	



Atlassian Data Lake

Access fully modeled data across your Atlassian tools in one place.

Learn more about Atlassian Data Lake.

	
	
	
	



Data connectors

Query your preferred non-Atlassian data sources and visualize alongside Atlassian data for holistic insights.

Learn more about data connectors.

	
	
	
	


Admin controls
				


Domain verification and account capture

Domain verification lets an organization admin centrally manage all of the Atlassian accounts that use the company's domain.

	
	
	
	



Session duration management (desktop)

Session duration management allows an organization admin to set a session timeout value different from the default policy of 30 days. This means admins can control how long a team member can stay signed in without interacting with Atlassian.com.

	
	
	
	



Admin key

Admin key lets site admins diagnose problems faster with temporary access to restricted pages. Page authors receive an email when a site admin has used admin key to view or make changes to their page.

	
	
	
	



Announcement banner

Create and manage critical announcements to ensure important messages are seen where your teams are actually working.

	
	
	
	



Copy space permissions

Copy permissions from one space to another to save time and prevent mistakes.

	
	
	
	



Admin insights

Confluence mission control allows product admins to quickly and easily access site-level insights and controls – all in one place. This includes a snapshot into overall site health and activity, providing greater oversight and management of Confluence site and spaces.

	
	
	
	



Sandbox

Prepare, test, and experiment with products and apps before making changes to your production environment.

The sandbox gives you a realistic understanding of what your new feature might look like or how it works when released for your users.

Learn more

	
	
	
	



Release tracks

Control when and how you release changes to users with release tracks.

With options to control Atlassian cloud releases, release tracks make your daily management of our cloud products more predictable. This helps you plan, prepare, and ensure success for upcoming product changes.

	
	
	
	



Product requests

Enable admins to manage how and when managed users create Atlassian products.

	
	
	
	



User counts

User counts gives Atlassian admins visibility into how many users they are able to add to an Enterprise product; and conversely, user counts indicate if a product is at-or-near capacity.

	
	
	
	


Security & Compliance
				


Atlassian Guard Standard (SSO, SCIM, mobile app management)

Proactively protect your mission-critical work with advanced authentication controls and flexible security policies.

Enforce Single Sign-on (SSO) and two-factor authentication

Automate user lifecycle management (SCIM provisioning)

Set policies for secure collaboration with external users

Seamless integration with your Identity provider (IdP)

	
Requires Atlassian Guard Standard subscription
	
Requires Atlassian Guard Standard subscription
	
Requires Atlassian Guard Standard subscription
	
Included



Atlassian Guard Premium (Data classification, threat detections, content scanning)

Guard your top-priority projects with our most advanced security capabilities and stop threats before they become incidents.

	
Requires Atlassian Guard Premium subscription
	
Requires Atlassian Guard Premium subscription
	
Requires Atlassian Guard Premium subscription
	
Requires Atlassian Guard Premium subscription



Password policies

Password policies help ensure best practices for user-created passwords in Atlassian cloud products. This helps reduce the risk of security breaches.

	
	
	
	



Encryption in transit and at rest

All customer data stored within Atlassian cloud products and services is encrypted in transit over public networks using Transport Layer Security (TLS) 1.2+ with Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) to protect it from unauthorized disclosure or modification.

Data drives on servers holding customer data and attachments in Jira Software Cloud, Jira Service Management Cloud, Jira Work Management Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Statuspage, Opsgenie, and Trello use full disk, industry-standard AES-256 encryption at rest.

	
	
	
	



Business continuity and disaster recovery

Our Disaster Recovery Program consists of a few key practices to ensure the appropriate levels of governance, oversight, and testing.

Learn more about security practices.

	
	
	
	



MDM (Mobile Device Management)

Enforce security controls on mobile app usage through built-in mobile device management (MDM) support for iOS and Android.

Learn more about MDM.

	
	
	
	



Audit logs

Audit logs let administrators look at changes made to your site. This is useful when you need to troubleshoot a problem or keep a record of important events, like changes to global permissions.

	
	
	
	



Data residency

Specify where you want your data hosted in Atlassian's global cloud footprint. This can help meet your corporate policies and compliance requirements.

Learn more about data residency.

	
	
Confluence & Jira only
	
Confluence & Jira only
	
Confluence & Jira only



IP allowlisting

Bolster your team’s security by limiting your site access to trusted IP ranges.

	
	
	
	



Multiple idP

Support multiple identity providers for a single organization.

Customers can now connect multiple identity providers to implement SAML SSO and SCIM user provisioning to their Atlassian Cloud organization.

	
	
	
	



Audit logs for user activity

Comprehensive audit logging of user-initiated activity in Confluence, including permission changes.

	
	
	
	


Storage, Support & Invoicing
				


Storage

Products in the Jira suite and Confluence all come with their own file storage space.

Learn more about storage.

	
2 GB file storage
	
250 GB file storage
	
Unlimited file storage
	
Unlimited file storage


Support
	
Community Support
	
Local Business Hours
	
24/7 Premium Support
	
24/7 Enterprise Support


Guaranteed uptime SLA
	
	
	
99.9%
	
99.95%



Centralized per-user licensing

With centralized per-user licensing, you can give a user entry into all sites (also called "instances") with a single license. Centralized per-user licensing is a subscription model.

	
	
	
	


External Collaboration
				


Public links

Public links allow users to share a view-only version of a Confluence page with anyone on the internet via the unique Public Link URL. Easily copy the link and share with external collaborators for easy viewing, without needing them to sign up for a Confluence account.

	
	
	
	



Guests

For each paid user, admins can add up to five guests for no additional cost or licenses.

There are no limits to how many spaces you can share or how many guests you can have in each space. However, each guest is limited to a single space.

	
	
	
	



Anonymous access

Anonymous access makes your Confluence site publicly available, enabling access to your content to users outside of your organization. Confluence's anonymous access is most commonly used for customer-facing knowledge bases and documentation.

	
	
	
	
Data Center Products

Data Center is our self-managed product offering for customers with strict regulatory or security requirements. To learn more about this offering, please contact us.

Simply enter how many users you have and choose a billing cycle (annual or monthly).</p><p>Our detailed cloud pricing tables include price ranges for our <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/licensing/confluence#what-does-a-confluence-cloud-standard-subscription-cost\">Standard</a> or <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/licensing/confluence#what-does-a-confluence-cloud-premium-subscription-cost\">Premium</a> plans on our purchasing and licensing site. <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/enterprise/contact?formType=pricing-quotes\">Contact our sales team</a> for Enterprise pricing, available only for annual subscriptions.</p>"}}},{"type":"accordion","parameters":{"header":{"type":"text","value":"About users & how you're billed for them"},"richText":{"type":"json","value":"<p>A <b>user</b> is someone who can log in to one of your Confluence sites and who exists in User Management. You can add and remove users as your team changes.</p><p>For <b>monthly</b> subscriptions, we'll charge you for the following month's subscription based on the exact number of Confluence users you have.</p><p>For <b>annual</b> subscriptions, we'll charge you for the tier that most closely matches your user count. Depending on the number of users purchased, annual subscriptions may be a better value.</p><p>See monthly and annual tiers for our <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/licensing/confluence#what-does-a-confluence-cloud-standard-subscription-cost\">Standard</a> or <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/licensing/confluence#what-does-a-confluence-cloud-premium-subscription-cost\">Premium</a> plan.</p>"}}},{"type":"accordion","parameters":{"header":{"type":"text","value":"Payment options"},"richText":{"type":"json","value":"<p>You can pay <b>monthly subscriptions</b> by credit card (MasterCard, Visa, or American Express) or PayPal.</p><p>For <b>annual subscriptions</b>, you can pay by credit card, bank transfer, or check.</p>"}}},{"type":"accordion","parameters":{"header":{"type":"text","value":"Free trial period, refunds, & subscription plan details"},"richText":{"type":"json","value":"<p>Our <b>Free plan</b> lets you try Confluence for up to 10 users with 2GB of storage and Community Support.</p><p>If you'd like to add more than 10 users or get access to more support and storage, you can sign up for a <b>7-day free trial</b> of our Standard or Premium plan. If you're on the Free plan and exceed the user limit, we'll automatically upgrade you to a 7-day free trial of the Standard plan.</p><p>Cancel any time, no payment information required.</p><p>We also offer <b>annual subscriptions</b> for Confluence. For these subscriptions, we'll bill you for the tier most closely matching your user count. Depending on the number of users purchased, annual subscriptions may be a better value.</p><p>If you're <b>unsatisfied</b> with any Atlassian Cloud product or service, we offer a refund. Monthly subscriptions are eligible for a refund within your first paid month and after your trial period ends. Annual subscriptions are eligible for a refund within 30 days of payment. <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/licensing/cloud#what-is-atlassian-refund-policy\">See how</a> to request a refund.</p>"}}},{"type":"accordion","parameters":{"header":{"type":"text","value":"Choosing Premium Plan over Standard"},"richText":{"type":"json","value":"<p>For organizations who need confidence in their ability to scale, the <b>Premium</b> plan offers 24/7 Premium Support with 1-hour response times for critical issues, unlimited storage, and a 99.9% uptime SLA financially backed by service credits.</p><p><a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/premium\">Confluence Cloud Premium</a> also provides an advanced toolkit to help admins better manage their Confluence site with more visibility and control.</p><p>New product features give administrators temporary access to restricted pages to resolve permissions issues fast. Analytics also offers deeper insights about your team’s site, space, and page use for better reporting, resource decisions, and content.</p>"}}},{"type":"accordion","parameters":{"header":{"type":"text","value":"Cloud and self-managed options"},"richText":{"type":"json","value":"<p><b>Important notice:</b> We've ended sales for new server licenses and will end support for server on Feb 15, 2024, PT. We’re continuing investment in Data Center with several key improvements. <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/migration/assess/journey-to-cloud\">Learn what this means for you.</a></p><p>Our <b>cloud</b> products provide a complete SaaS solution, ready-made for all Atlassian customers. With cloud, we do the heavy lifting for you by providing built-in platform security and compliance, quick and simple set up, and financially backed SLAs for uptime and performance. Cloud comes with the added benefit of continuous innovation so your end-users will always have the latest and greatest features and functionality.</p><p>Our <b>Data Center (or, “self-managed”)</b> products enable you the flexibility to deploy on an infrastructure of your choice. You’ll have control over data management, security and compliance, when you upgrade, and how you manage uptime and performance.</p><p><a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/migration/assess/compare-cloud-data-center\">Learn more about the differences</a>, or <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/migration/assess/migration-assessment\">take our assessment</a> to see which option best meets your organization’s needs.</p>"}}},{"type":"accordion","parameters":{"header":{"type":"text","value":"Atlassian Guard and Premium plan"},"richText":{"type":"json","value":"<p><a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/premium\">Confluence Cloud Premium</a> lets teams confidently scale with automation, a 99.9% uptime SLA, unlimited storage, Premium Support, and more features coming soon.</p><p>For security-conscious organizations that need more visibility and flexible controls in Atlassian cloud, <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/software/access\">Atlassian Guard Standard</a> helps secure and manage users. You can automate manual processes and introduce security guardrails to reduce risk and free up time.</p><p>For highly complex or regulated organizations with needs that go beyond centralized visibility and proactive controls, <a href=\"https://www.atlassian.com/software/guard/guard-premium\">Atlassian Guard Premium</a> offers the granularity to classify your organization’s data, alerts you of anomalous activity, and helps you investigate potential threats across Atlassian cloud.</p><p>When you layer Atlassian Guard on top of our Premium plan, you’ll get an enterprise-grade solution that lets you scale and secure Atlassian cloud content and users across your entire organization.</p>"}}}]},"parameters":{"gapv2":{"type":"dex-token-selector-parameter","value":{}},"label":{"type":"text","value":"Accordions container"},"spacing":{"type":"dex-space-control-parameter","value":{"mobile":{},"tablet":{},"desktop":{}}},"orientation":{"type":"dex-segmented-control-parameter","value":{}}}}]},"parameters":{"gapv2":{"type":"dex-token-selector-parameter","value":{"mobile":"500"}},"label":{"type":"text","value":"Content container"},"spacing":{"type":"dex-space-control-parameter","value":{}},"orientation":{"type":"dex-segmented-control-parameter","value":{}}}}]}},{"type":"blockContainer","_pattern":"2a8eeda7-c76c-477b-85df-84aaf34f12e2","parameters":{"gapv2":{"type":"dex-token-selector-parameter","value":{}},"spacing":{"type":"dex-space-control-parameter","value":{"mobile":{"marginTop":"500","marginBottom":"500"}}},"orientation":{"type":"dex-segmented-control-parameter","value":{}},"label":{"type":"text","value":"Questions Content"}},"slots":{"component":[{"type":"contentBlock","parameters":{"alignment":{"type":"select","value":"start"},"text":{"type":"text","value":"We got answers.
